title: Estonia plans to send over 70 locomotives to Ukraine, first deliveries possible this year
summary: The initiative could eventually deliver more than 70 locomotives, although the final number and delivery arrangements have not yet been determined.

title: Ukrainian forces reportedly strike Crimean Bridge after Russian missiles hit Kyiv bridges
summary: The attack came shortly after Russian forces launched a massive ballistic missile attack across Ukraine and hit the Northern and Southern Bridges across the Dnipro River in Kyiv.

title: European foreign ministers call on EU to crack down on Russian crypto networks
summary: “Our sanctions against Russia must hold even when money finds new ways to move," said Finnish Foreign Minister Elina Valtonen. "We must stop war cryptos and squeeze Russia’s war chest with new targeted sanctions and enhanced international cooperation.”

title: Key bridges in Kyiv struck in massive Russian ballistic missile attack across Ukraine
summary: "Preliminary reports indicate that there were impacts on the North and South bridges in the capital city," Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko said.
